Title: Guest who joined an open group pre-order sees the menu
Preconditions: R1 is Reserved, group is Open. Guest has the invite link and has not joined yet.
Steps:
1. Open the R1 invite link in a new browser.
2. Enter the name "Anna" and confirm.
Expected result:
1. The menu screen opens.
2. Dishes of L1 are shown.

Title: Guest cannot add dishes after the Owner submitted the group pre-order
Preconditions: G1 joined R1. The Owner submitted the group pre-order (group = Submitted).
Steps:
1. As G1, reload the menu page.
2. Click Pre-Order on D1.
Expected result:
1. G1 sees a message that the group pre-order is closed.
2. D1 is not added to the subcart.

Title: Guest cannot add dishes when the reservation is cancelled
Preconditions: G1 joined R1. The Owner cancelled R1 (reservation = Cancelled). The group was not submitted.
Steps:
1. As G1, reload the menu page.
2. Click Pre-Order on D1.
Expected result:
1. G1 sees a message that the reservation is cancelled.
2. D1 is not added to the subcart.

Title: Menu is not usable before the guest enters a name
Preconditions: Guest opens the R1 invite link for the first time.
Steps:
1. Open the R1 invite link.
2. Try to close the name dialog with Esc and with the close (X) button.
3. Press Tab several times to reach a Pre-Order button.
Expected result:
1. The name dialog stays open.
2. No Pre-Order button can be reached or clicked until the guest joins.

Title: Menu shows all dishes of the reservation's location and only them
Preconditions: G1 joined R1.
Steps:
1. Open the menu as G1.
2. Compare the dishes shown with the L1 dish list in the admin panel or API.
Expected result:
1. All 7 dishes of L1 are shown, including unavailable D4 and D5.
2. D8 (from L2) is not shown.

Title: Dishes are grouped by category in a fixed order
Preconditions: G1 joined R1.
Steps:
1. Open the menu as G1.
2. Check the category groups and their order.
Expected result:
1. Groups appear in this order: Appetizers (D1, D6), Main Courses (D2, D4, D7), Desserts (D3, D5).
2. Each dish appears in exactly one group, and it is the correct one.

Title: Empty category is hidden
Preconditions: Admin removed all desserts (D3, D5) from L1. G1 joined R1.
Steps: 1. Open the menu as G1.
Expected result:
1. No Desserts group or tab is shown.
2. No empty section is left on the page.

Title: Dish card shows name, price, weight, image and status
Preconditions: G1 joined R1.
Steps:
1. Open the menu as G1.
2. Find the D1 card and compare it with the D1 data in the admin panel or API.
Expected result:
1. The card shows: name, price, weight in grams, image and availability status.
2. Every value matches the source data.

Title: Price is shown with currency and two decimals
Preconditions: G1 joined R1. Admin set D2 price = 9.
Steps:
1. Open the menu as G1.
2. Read the D1 and D2 prices.

Title: Serving size is shown in grams
Preconditions: G1 joined R1.
Steps:
1. Open the menu as G1.
2. Read the weight on the D1 card.
Expected result: 1. The weight is shown as "250 g".

Title: Dish without an image shows a placeholder
Preconditions: G1 joined R1.
Steps:
1. Open the menu as G1.
2. Find the D6 card.
Expected result:
1. A placeholder image is shown, with no broken-image icon.
2. The card layout matches the other cards.
3. The image alt text is the dish name.

Title: Long dish name does not break the card
Preconditions: G1 joined R1.
Steps:
1. Open the menu as G1 at 1440 px and at 375 px width.
2. Find the D7 card.
Expected result:
1. The name wraps or is shortened with "…", and the full name can still be read.
2. Price, weight and the Pre-Order button stay visible and aligned.

Title: Available dish shows its availability status
Preconditions: G1 joined R1.
Steps:
1. Open the menu as G1.
2. Check the D1 card for an availability status.
Expected result: 1. D1 shows the status "Available" (or the label the design defines).

Title: Guest adds an available dish to the subcart
Preconditions: G1 joined R1. G1's subcart is empty.
Steps:
1. Click Pre-Order on D1.
2. Open the subcart.
Expected result:
1. A confirmation is shown after step 1.
2. The subcart has D1 with quantity 1, price $12.50 and total $12.50.

Title: Adding the same dish twice increases the quantity
Preconditions: G1 joined R1. G1's subcart is empty.
Steps:
1. Click Pre-Order on D1 two times.
2. Open the subcart.
Expected result:
1. The subcart has one D1 line with quantity 2.
2. The total is $25.00.

Title: Guest adds dishes from different categories
Preconditions: G1 joined R1. G1's subcart is empty.
Steps:
1. Click Pre-Order on D1, D2 and D3.
2. Open the subcart.
Expected result:
1. The subcart has 3 lines with quantity 1 each.
2. The total equals the sum of the 3 prices.

Title: Subcart is personal to each guest
Preconditions: G1 (browser A) and G2 (browser B) joined R1. Both subcarts are empty.
Steps:
1. In browser A, as G1, click Pre-Order on D1.
2. In browser B, as G2, open the subcart.
3. In browser A, as G1, open the subcart.
Expected result:
1. G2's subcart is empty.
2. G1's subcart has D1.

Title: On Stop dish is clearly marked as unavailable
Preconditions: G1 joined R1.
Steps:
1. Open the menu as G1.
2. Find the D4 card.
Expected result:
1. D4 has the text label "On Stop" (not only a colour).
2. The card looks different from available dishes (e.g., greyed out).

Title: On Stop dish cannot be added with the mouse
Preconditions: G1 joined R1. G1's subcart is empty. DevTools Network tab is open.
Steps:
1. Click Pre-Order on D4.
2. Click on the D4 card itself.
3. Open the subcart.
Expected result:
1. The Pre-Order button is disabled.
2. No confirmation is shown and no add-dish request is sent.
3. The subcart is empty.

Title: On Stop dish cannot be added with the keyboard
Preconditions: G1 joined R1. G1's subcart is empty.
Steps:
1. Use Tab to move focus to the D4 card.
2. Press Enter, then Space.
3. Open the subcart.
Expected result:
1. D4's Pre-Order button cannot be activated from the keyboard.
2. The subcart is empty.

Title: Out of Stock dish is marked and cannot be added
Preconditions: G1 joined R1. G1's subcart is empty.
Steps:
1. Open the menu as G1.
2. Check the D5 card.
3. Click Pre-Order on D5.
Expected result:
1. D5 has the label "Out of Stock".
2. The button is disabled, and D5 is not added.

Title: Dish that went On Stop after the menu loaded cannot be added
Preconditions: G1 joined R1 and has the menu open. D2 is Available.
Steps:
1. Admin sets D2 to On Stop.
2. Without reloading, G1 clicks Pre-Order on D2.
3. Open the subcart.
Expected result:
1. G1 sees an error saying D2 is no longer available.
2. D2 is not added to the subcart.

Title: Status change is shown after a page reload
Preconditions: G1 joined R1 and has the menu open. D2 is Available.
Steps:
1. Admin sets D2 to On Stop.
2. G1 reloads the page.
3. Admin sets D2 back to Available.
4. G1 reloads the page.
Expected result:
1. After step 2, D2 is shown as On Stop and cannot be added.
2. After step 4, D2 is Available and can be added.

Title: Price change and new dish are shown after a page reload
Preconditions: G1 joined R1 and has the menu open.
Test data: D1 new price 14; new dish D9 (Dessert, Available)
Steps:
1. Admin changes the D1 price to 14 and adds D9 to L1.
2. G1 reloads the page.
Expected result:
1. D1 shows "$14.00".
2. D9 appears under Desserts.

Title: Loading state is shown while the menu loads
Preconditions: G1 joined R1. DevTools network throttling = Slow 3G.
Steps: 1. Reload the menu page.
Expected result:
1. A loading indicator is shown until the dishes appear.
2. No error or "empty menu" message flashes during loading.

Title: Empty menu shows a message
Preconditions: Reservation at L3 (no dishes), group Open, guest joined.
Steps: 1. Open the menu.
Expected result:
1. A clear message says the menu is empty.
2. The page layout is not broken.

Title: Menu load error shows a message and a way to retry
Preconditions: G1 joined R1. In DevTools, block the menu request (or go offline).
Steps:
1. Reload the menu page.
2. Unblock the request (or go online) and retry.
Expected result:
1. An error message is shown, and the page does not crash.
2. After the retry, the menu loads.

Title: Menu works on a 375 px mobile screen
Preconditions: G1 joined R1. Browser width = 375 px (DevTools device mode).
Steps:
1. Open the menu.
2. Scroll through all categories.
3. Click Pre-Order on D1.
Expected result:
1. No horizontal scrolling.
2. Cards, prices and statuses are readable.
3. D1 is added.

Title: Menu can be used with the keyboard only
Preconditions: G1 joined R1.
Steps:
1. Use Tab to go through the menu.
2. Press Enter on D1's Pre-Order button.
Expected result:
1. Focus is visible and moves in a logical order.
2. D1 is added.
3. The status of D4 is shown as text, not only by colour.
